usedFor: Wildapricot holds members, payments and events, and HubSpot receives their status on contacts through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Membership Is Enabled” in Wildapricot, then “Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A member's status change updates the matching HubSpot contact, found by email.

watchOut: “Update Contact” works on an existing contact by email, so the member must already be in HubSpot.
